latin.note: Open-licence period serif, after the 19th-century Modern faces of American newspapers. Fonts are not committed: fonts.py --fetch installs the pinned npm package into a cache and checks both hashes.

chr.note: Traced from the Cherokee Phoenix's own glyphs by ocr/models/chr-phoenix/recipe/chr_trace_font.py (#1620). The font file is not in the repository: only the recipe is, and it needs the glyph bank. Give the built Phoenix1828.ttf with --font chr=PATH to render Cherokee.
